CRAH-4 is also on UPS-B, so one panel event hits pumps, CH-1 controls and a CRAH
The data hall door controller sits on the BMS switch (which is on UPS-B)
Acme Cloud's 99.99% SLA depends on the chilled water plant

Landlord's obligation depends on the chilled water plant serving Data Hall A.
